title: GAP-43 in adult visual cortex.
abstract: GAP-43 was purified from cat brain by a rapid isolation procedure and was used to raise highly specific polyclonal antibodies in rabbits. Immunoblots of proteins from adult cat, monkey and human visual cortex as well as bovine cortex also showed specific staining of a single protein that was present in both soluble and membrane fractions. Immunocytochemistry of both cat and human adult visual cortex showed that GAP-43 has a laminar distribution.
